title_en: See Why Ram V and Evan Cagle's Deicidium Returned Is One of 2026's Most Promising New Graphic Novels
summary_en: The team behind DC's critically acclaimed New Gods relaunch are back with Deicidium Returned, and it's one of the most exciting new graphic novels of 2026.
body_en:
DC's All In initiative has been responsible for some pretty great comics in the last couple of years, but it's tough to top Ram V and Evan Cagle's New Gods. Luckily, while that series only lasted 12 issues, the creators are reuniting for a new graphic novel called Deicidium Returned. That's enough to immediately make it one of our most anticipated books in the months ahead.
With the final order cutoff for Deicidium Returned happening on October 5, IGN can exclusively debut the first 24 pages of this graphic novel. Feast your eyes on this gorgeous comic bookery in the slideshow gallery below:
Decidium Returned is written by Ram V, with art by Evan Cagle and Anand Radhakrishnan. The book is published through Image Comics. Here's the official summary:
"A daring heist. A pair of thieves in slums around a holy city. A biker gang of graverobbers around a mausoleum town. A protest at the foot of a sacred mountain. This is how DEICIDIUM begins," V tells IGN. "Separate threads, looking at the lives of ordinary, seemingly unconnected people in a world that is run by faith, worship and the commerce of belief. An explosive revelation is to follow. Something old was stolen. Something ancient is broken. Clever machiavellian fingers pulling at long-forgotten threads. What if these ordinary people with loves, lives and lingering regrets...what if these people were actually gods? Would we love them? Hate them? Hold them up or would we kill them?"
Deicidium Returned will be released on November 11. You can preorder a copy on Amazon .
For more, find out about the Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man prequel comic and learn which major comics icon finally joined the Marvel Universe in Avengers: Armageddon #4.
